بُرْدٌ مُفَوَّفٌ : see فُوفٌ, latter half. ―
-b2- غُرْفَةٌ مُفَوَّفَةٌ, the mention of which occurs in a trad. of Kaab, means [An upper chamber] whereof one brick is of gold and another of silver [i. e. constructed of gold and silver bricks alternately]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
